summary: Fix 5 issues in the Todo API: input validation, error handling, data integrity, missing features, and security basics.

tasks.title: Add input validation for POST /todos
tasks.description: The API accepts empty titles and excessively long titles. Add validation to reject invalid input early.
instructions: Read src/server.js to understand the current POST /todos handler
After line where body is parsed (const body = await parseBody(req)), add validation:
- Check that body.title exists and is a string
- Check that body.title.trim().length > 0
- Check that body.title.length <= 500
If validation fails, return 400 with { error: 'Title is required and must be 1-500 characters' }
Add the same validation to the PUT /todos/:id handler for the title field

tasks.title: Add proper error handling for JSON parsing
tasks.description: When the request body is not valid JSON, the server returns 500 instead of 400. Fix the parseBody function to handle malformed JSON.
instructions: Read src/server.js to find the parseBody function
Wrap the JSON.parse(body) call in a try-catch
If JSON.parse throws, resolve with null instead of crashing
In each route handler that calls parseBody, check if the result is null
If null, return 400 with { error: 'Invalid JSON in request body' }
Apply this to POST /todos and PUT /todos/:id handlers

tasks.title: Add file locking for concurrent writes
tasks.description: Multiple simultaneous requests can corrupt data.json. Add a simple mutex lock to prevent concurrent writes.
instructions: At the top of src/server.js, add a writeLock variable: let writeLock = Promise.resolve();
Create a helper function acquireLock() that chains onto writeLock
Create a helper function releaseLock() that resolves the current lock
Wrap the saveTodos call in acquireLock()/releaseLock()
This ensures only one write happens at a time
Do NOT change the loadTodos function - reads can happen concurrently

tasks.title: Add filtering and pagination to GET /todos
tasks.description: The GET /todos endpoint returns all todos. Add query parameters for filtering by status and pagination.
instructions: Read src/server.js to find the GET /todos handler
Parse query parameters from url.searchParams:
- 'completed' (boolean): filter by completed status
- 'page' (number, default 1): page number
- 'limit' (number, default 20, max 100): items per page
Apply the completed filter if specified
Apply pagination: slice the array based on page and limit
Return { todos: [...], total: N, page: P, limit: L } instead of just the array
Add tests for filtering and pagination in server.test.js

tasks.title: Add basic rate limiting
tasks.description: Add a simple in-memory rate limiter to prevent abuse. Limit to 100 requests per minute per IP.
instructions: Create a new file src/rate-limiter.js
Implement a Map that tracks request counts per IP
Export a function checkRateLimit(ip) that returns true if allowed, false if exceeded
Export a function cleanup() that removes entries older than 1 minute
In src/server.js, import checkRateLimit from './rate-limiter.js'
At the start of the request handler, check rate limit
If exceeded, return 429 with { error: 'Too many requests' }
Add tests for rate limiting in src/rate-limiter.test.js
